results.title: Vietnam courts European investment, but regulatory hurdles loom - Nikkei Asia
results.snippet: HANOI -- Vietnam is stepping up efforts to attract European investment after upgrading ties with the European Union, but regulatory uncertainty and market barriers risk complicating Hanoi's push to turn deepening political ties into concrete business projects.
